entries.70a186ac074ca67e: A business that buys and sells used motorcycles. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥6,748 million, making it the largest business. It attracts customers through digital marketing, accepts online appraisals on its own website "Bike Kaitori.com", and collects vehicles through on-site appraisals made by visiting customers' homes. Most of the motorcycles purchased are sold at inter-dealer auctions, and some are sold directly to users at "Bikeland Direct Sales Center". It operates under the single brand "Bikeland", with purchase bases in the Kanto, Kansai, Tokai, Tohoku and Kyushu regions.
entries.77caa37df5b743ab: A sales channel in which purchased motorcycles are put up for sale at dealer-only auctions. The system allows motorcycles to be sold within an average of 1 month after purchase, and sales in the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥6,070 million.
entries.79a1e083f2c4a89e: Because vehicles are collected through on-site appraisals based on customer information gathered through digital marketing, it can operate a wide sales area at low cost regardless of store location. It consolidates the latest auction market prices in its own database, which leads to quick and accurate appraisals and price offers. Since it sells most of the motorcycles it purchases at auction within 1 month on average, it has a feature of low inventory risk.
